typography-base-limited-lines_3PbqM" style="line-clamp:2;-webkit-line-clamp:2">TikTok is heading to #TIFF26 to spotlight creators, emerging filmmakers and the fans moving film culture forward.This September, TikTok is proud to return as the Official Platform Partner at the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF), and presenting partner for the Special Presentations programme, bringing creators, filmmakers and industry leaders together to celebrate the people and communities shaping the future of storytelling.Every day, creators and film fans come to TikTok to discover new voices, share their perspectives and build communities around the stories they love. Over the past year, 12M+ posts about Film & TV were published everyday globally¹ and 35% of TikTok users say content on the platform gives them the confidence to try a new movie or show.²"TIFF is where the film industry comes together to discover what's next, and our platform is where a global community of over a billion people discovers new stories, builds fandom around the films and performances they love, and turns festival moments into conversations that start in Toronto and find global reach," said Dawn Yang, Global Head of Entertainment, TikTok. "Creators are a vital part of how that happens, so we're proud to be bringing 30 #FilmTok creators to the festival this year. They'll offer cinephiles around the world a front row seat to the films and voices defining what's next in storytelling."#FilmTok creators bring the excitement of TIFF to the TikTok CommunityAs the film world gathers in Toronto for #TIFF26, TikTok will be on the ground with creators, spotlighting emerging filmmakers and giving audiences an authentic, behind-the-scenes look at the festival. interviews and Festival events, participating creators will bring audiences closer to the films, filmmakers and performances generating conversation throughout TIFF.The creators attending TIFF style="line-clamp:2;-webkit-line-clamp:2">On TikTok, the comment section isn't just a place to react — It's where a video's story keeps going: where jokes get funnier, reactions get bigger, and total strangers connect in real time.Features like text, photo, and video sticker comments give people new ways to say more than words ever could, turning the comment section into an experience of its own. Every day, that adds up to more than 1.7 billion comments shared across the platform.Today, we're building on that innovation with a series of new updates:React out loud with Voice CommentsSound and music have shaped TikTok from the very beginning, turning songs into trends and audio clips into jokes shared across the app. Now, we're bringing that same energy to the comment section with Voice Comments, a new way to post and listen to audio messages directly under any video.To leave a voice comment, just tap the microphone icon in the comment box and record a message up to 60 seconds long. Once posted, anyone can tap to listen, turning the comment section into a place people can hear as much as read. Whether you’re laughing at a meme, singing with a creator, or reacting to a sudden plot twist, Voice Comments make it easy to say what you’re feeling — no typing required. Voice Comments are rolling out globally over the next month to accounts 18 and older.Let viewers vote directly in the comments with Comment PollsCreators have always found creative ways to turn the comment section into a conversation with their audience. To make that easier, we're announcing Comment Polls, a new way for creators to put decisions directly in their followers' hands. Whether it's picking an outfit, deciding what to cook, or voting on the next video idea.To create a Comment Poll, creators can add a poll when commenting on their own video. Just tap the poll icon in the comment box, choose up to 5 options for followers to vote on, and set a timeframe for how long voting will last. As votes come in, creators can track results directly in the comment section, making it easy to see how the conversation is trending in real time. Comment Polls are now available globally.Take photo comments to the next level with Photo Carousel and Live Photo CommentsPhoto comments have become one of the most loved ways people express themselves on TikTok. And we're making the feature even more useful with two updates: Photo Carousel Comments and Live Photo Comments.With Photo Carousel Comments, people can now add up to 9 photos in a single comment, making it easy to share a full moment instead of just one frame. For instance, if someone wants to react to a travel video with their own vacation photos, they no longer have to pick just one, they can drop the whole album in a single comment.Live Photos capture more than a static image, they capture a moment. With Live Photo Comments, people can upload Live Photos directly from their camera roll, giving the photo comment a brief burst of motion so others get a quick preview of the moment before diving into the full image. Live Photo Comments are now available globally, and Photo Carousel Comments are rolling out globally over the next month.We’re excited to see how creators and fans take reactions to the next level trends and soundtracking millions of moments with an incredibly diverse mix of music.Today, TikTok can reveal its annual Songs of the Summer list, celebrating the songs, artists and trends that defined the season on TikTok and made Summer 2026 one for the history books.TikTok's Global Song of the Summer 2026TikTok can reveal that the #1 Global Song of the Summer 2026 is Katy Perry's 'The One That Got Away'.'The One That Got Away' was on Katy Perry's phenomenally successful 'Teenage Dream' album and was first released as a single in 2011. The track has been discovered by a new generation on TikTok this summer, where the community has used it to soundtrack over 42 million videos and over 55 billion video views, and catapulted it back into the charts worldwide, including the Billboard Global 200 chart where it has spent the last 21 weeks. The track - which now has over 1.8bn streams on Spotify - fueled a wave of nostalgic, emotionally driven content on the platform – from covers and TV edits to personal “the one that got away” reflections including Katy's own reaction to the famous ex she wrote the song about. The track's resurgence led Katy Perry (10m followers) to release a director’s cut featuring new narration from rock legend Stevie Nicks.Katy Perry said: “It's surreal to see The One That Got Away having this moment, all these years later. The thing about music is that you never really know where a song is going to end up, or when someone is going to find it. From seeing it being chosen in the “choose your own adventure” section of my Lifetimes Tour concert film to seeing people discover it on TikTok and make it part of their own stories has been really special to watch. It’s nice to revisit an amazing chapter while watching another unfold.”  @tiktok this summer was all about the classic hits. here's to the ones that never got away 💿 #SongsofTheSummer2026 ♬ original sound - TikTok   TikTok's US Songs of the SummerKaty Perry's banger may have taken over our feeds, but the TikTok community in the US also embraced quite the range of songs to soundtrack this summer.As 2016 nostalgia swept TikTok this summer, Mac Miller's 'Cinderella (feat. Ty Dolla $ign)' became one of TikTok's biggest love songs of the summer, landing at #2 on the US list. Creators used the track to celebrate their significant others through heartfelt photos and relationship edits.Lenny Kravitz's 1991 hit 'It Ain't Over 'Til It's Over' took the #3 spot, with the TikTok community embracing the song after being featured in FX's Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. and Carolyn Bessette. The track quickly took over For You feeds, with creators discussing the series and pairing the song with adorable pet videos.Malcolm Todd's 'Earrings' found a whole new wave of fans on TikTok this summer, earning the #4 spot on the US list. The dreamy track became the perfect soundtrack for TV romance edits and heartfelt covers all summer long.Shakira and Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' became the anthem of our soccer-filled summer, earning the #9 spot on the US list. Creators celebrated countries from every corner of the world and recreated Shakira's iconic dance moves, turning TikTok into a global celebration. Something so catchy you can't help but start singing it yourself, even if you don't know the words. This year's crown goes to 'Du Bist Gut Genug' ('You are good enough') by KITSCHKRIEG feat. Blumengarten and Shirin David, the viral track better known by many on TikTok as "Doobie Scoot Canoe". The TikTok global community has had a whole lot of fun with the German lyrics, inspiring thousands of hilarious videos, memes, and creator interpretations (including by BTS' Jung Kook, Steve Lacy and Lizzo) that has become one of the season's most joyful shared jokes. Do your own thing, and if it's good, it connects — and people will carry it all around the world on TikTok."💚 Boyband of the Summer: CORTISCelebrating the artists who helped drive K-pop discovery and community on TikTok this summer. g%20Midnight%20Sun%20this%20summer%2C%20and%20who%20truly%20embodies%20the%20spirit%20of%20Pop%20Girl%20Summer.%20Giving%20us%20infectious%20pop%20anthems%20and%20viral%20choreography%2C%20as%20well%20as%20viral%20make%20up%20trends%2C%20fan%20edits%20and%20behind%20the%20scenes%20looks%20at%20a%20superstar%20in%20the%20making%2C%20Zara%20Larsson%20and%20her%20remix%20album%2C%20'Midnight%20Sun%3A%20Girls%20Trip'%2C%20is%20the%20living%20embodiment%20of%20summer%20vibes%2C%20soundtracking%20all%20of%20our%20summers%20on%20TikTok%2C%20and%20sending%20Zara%20Larsson's%20career%20into%20the%20stratosphere.%F0%9F%98%82%20Misheard%20Track%20of%20the%20Summer%3A%20'Du%20Bist%20Gut%20Genug'Every%20summer%20needs%20that%20one%20viral%20sound%20of%20the%20season.%20Something%20so%20catchy%20you%20can't%20help%20but%20start%20singing%20it%20yourself%2C%20even%20if%20you%20don't%20know%20the%20words.%20This%20year's%20crown%20goes%20to%20'Du%20Bist%20Gut%20Genug'%20('You%20are%20good%20enough')%20by%20KITSCHKRIEG%20feat.%20Blumengarten%20and%20Shirin%20David%2C%20the%20viral%20track%20better%20known%20by%20many%20on%20TikTok%20as%20%5C%22Doobie%20Scoot%20Canoe%5C%22.%20The%20TikTok%20global%20community%20has%20had%20a%20whole%20lot%20of%20fun%20with%20the%20German%20lyrics%2C%20inspiring%20thousands%20of%20hilarious%20videos%2C%20memes%2C%20and%20creator%20interpretations%20(including%20by%20BTS'%20Jung%20Kook%2C%20Steve%20Lacy%20and%20Lizzo)%20that%20has%20become%20one%20of%20the%20season's%20most%20joyful%20shared%20jokes.%20And%2C%20with%20two%20new%20versions%20now%20released%20featuring%20Skepta%20and%20Omah%20Lay%2C%20that%20joke%20will%20run%20and%20run..KITSCHKRIEG%20said%3A%20%5C%22Beyond%20the%20virality%2C%20what%20really%20mattered%20to%20us%20was%20proving%20you%20can%20do%20it%20on%20your%20own%20terms.%20We%20were%20always%20told%20black%20and%20white%20doesn't%20work%2C%2016%3A9%20doesn't%20work%20-%20%5C%22Gut%20Genug%5C%22%20proved%20otherwise.%20Do%20your%20own%20thing%2C%20and%20if%20it's%20good%2C%20it%20connects%20%E2%80%94%20and%20people%20will%20carry%20it%20all%20around%20the%20world%20on%20TikTok.%5C%22%F0%9F%92%9A%20Boyband%20of%20the%20Summer%3A%20CORTISCelebrating%20the%20artists%20who%20helped%20drive%20K-pop%20discovery%20and%20community%20on%20TikTok%20this%20summer.%20Everyone%20was%20hitting%20their%20iconic%20choreo%20including%20KATSEYE%2C%20LE%20SSERAFIM%2C%20and%20BTS'%20j-hope.%20From%20fan%20edits%20and%20dance%20challenges%20to%20performance%20clips%20and%20creative%20trends%2C%20CORTIS%20inspired%20fans%20around%20the%20world%20to%20celebrate%20the%20genre%20and%20connect%20through%20music.CORTIS%20said%3A%20%E2%80%9CWe%E2%80%99re%20so%20proud%20that%20%E2%80%98REDRED%E2%80%99%20is%20selected%20as%20one%20of%20TikTok%E2%80%99s%20Songs%20of%20the%20Summer!%20We%20love%20seeing%20how%20the%20TikTok%20community%20discovers%20our%20music%20and%20brings%20their%20own%20creativity%20to%20it.%20The%20response%20to%20%E2%80%98REDRED%E2%80%99%20has%20been%20incredible%2C%20and%20we%E2%80%99re%20so%20grateful%20to%20COER%20and%20everyone%20who%20has%20listened%2C%20created%20and%20made%20the%20song%20part%20of%20their%20summer.%5C%22%F0%9F%9A%80%20Emerging%20Artist%20of%20the%20Summer%3A%20SlayyyterRecognizing%20the%20breakthrough%20artist%20who%20captured%20the%20attention%20of%20TikTok's%20global%20community%20this%20summer.%20Some%20TikTok%20favourites%20like%20Keke%20Palmer%20and%20Camila%20Mendes%20used%20%5C%22DANCE...%5C%22%20to%20show%20us%20their%20iconic%20moves.%20Through%20creative%20fan%20content%2C%20viral%20moments%20and%20growing%20momentum%20on%20and%20off%20the%20platform%2C%20Slayyyter%20reached%20new%20audiences%20around%20the%20world%20and%20cemented%20herself%20as%20one%20of%20the%20season's%20standout%20new%20voices.Songs%20of%20the%20Summer%2C%20Vol.%202026TikTok%20is%20celebrating%20the%20Songs%20of%20the%20Summer%202026%20with%20the%20launch%20of%20a%20major%20new%20social%20campa TikTok Privacy Center Newsroom September 08, 2026 • Community , News TikTok returns to TIFF, celebrating the creators and fans shaping film fandom TikTok is heading to #TIFF26 to spotlight creators, emerging filmmakers and the fans moving film culture forward.This September, TikTok is proud to return as the Official Platform Partner at the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF), and presenting partner for the Special Presentations programme, bringing creators, filmmakers and industry leaders together to celebrate the people and communities shaping the future of storytelling.Every day, creators and film fans come to TikTok to discover new voices, share their perspectives and build communities around the stories they love. Over the past year, 12M+ posts about Film & TV were published everyday globally¹ and 35% of TikTok users say content on the platform gives them the confidence to try a new movie or show.²"TIFF is where the film industry comes together to discover what's next, and our platform is where a global community of over a billion people discovers new stories, builds fandom around the films and performances they love, and turns festival moments into conversations that start in Toronto and find global reach," said Dawn Yang, Global Head of Entertainment, TikTok. "Creators are a vital part of how that happens, so we're proud to be bringing 30 #FilmTok creators to the festival this year. They'll offer cinephiles around the world a front row seat to the films and voices defining what's next in storytelling."#FilmTok creators bring the excitement of TIFF to the TikTok CommunityAs the film world gathers in Toronto for #TIFF26, TikTok will be on the ground with creators, spotlighting emerging filmmakers and giving audiences an authentic, behind-the-scenes look at the festival. This inside look will be facilitated by more than 30 creators who will be in Toronto — the largest group of #FilmTok cinephiles that we've ever brought to TIFF.From premieres and red carpets to cast interviews and Festival events, participating creators will bring audiences closer to the films, filmmakers and performances generating conversation throughout TIFF.The creators attending TIFF talent conversations that cinephiles around the world are waiting to see. As the connective thread between TIFF and a global community of film lovers, creators will bring the festival to audiences far outside of Toronto - all through the eyes of #FilmTok creators who are just as obsessed.TikTok at TIFF: The MarketTikTok will also bring actors, creators and industry leaders together to examine how discovery and fandom are building excitement surrounding new film content at a global scale. As part of TIFF's inaugural edition of The Market, TikTok will host a special conversation with Caleb Hearon and Zooey Deschanel on September 12. Trash Mountain stars Zooey Deschanel and breakout writer and actor Caleb Hearon will join TikTok's Jenny Kim, Global Entertainment Partnerships Lead, for a conversation exploring the evolving paths creators are taking into feature film, the creative freedom of modern storytelling, and how audiences discover, rediscover and champion stories. From new releases to beloved classics like New Girl and 500 Days of Summer, the conversation will explore what makes stories resonate, endure and find new audiences on the FYF.Where Film Discovery and Fandom Come TogetherCommunities including #FilmTok and #MovieTok give audiences a place to champion emerging filmmakers, share recommendations, revisit beloved titles and connect over the stories they love.That influence extends across the life of a title. Thirty-eight percent of viewers say content on TikTok has inspired them to rewatch an older movie or show,² demonstrating how the community can introduce stories to new audiences and bring established favorites back into the cultural conversation.As an official sponsor of TIFF 2026, TikTok is excited to celebrate the creators, filmmakers and fans shaping film culture and bring their perspectives into conversations about the industry’s future.Explore the official TIFF experience on TikTok by searching #TIFF26 and don't forget to follow along at @tiff_net to join the conversation from September 10 - 20, 2026.Sources:TikTok Global In-App Analysis, June 2025–June 2026.TikTok Publishers Global, Entertainment Messaging Research, Ipsos, Jun.–Jul. 2025 September 03, 2026 • Product Say More in the Comments: Introducing Voice, Polls, and Carousels on TikTok On TikTok, the comment section isn't just a place to react — It's where a video's story keeps going: where jokes get funnier, reactions get bigger, and total strangers connect in real time.Features like text, photo, and video sticker comments give people new ways to say more than words ever could, turning the comment section into an experience of its own. Every day, that adds up to more than 1.7 billion comments shared across the platform.Today, we're building on that innovation with a series of new updates:React out loud with Voice CommentsSound and music have shaped TikTok from the very beginning, turning songs into trends and audio clips into jokes shared across the app. Now, we're bringing that same energy to the comment section with Voice Comments, a new way to post and listen to audio messages directly under any video.To leave a voice comment, just tap the microphone icon in the comment box and record a message up to 60 seconds long. Once posted, anyone can tap to listen, turning the comment section into a place people can hear as much as read. Whether you’re laughing at a meme, singing with a creator, or reacting to a sudden plot twist, Voice Comments make it easy to say what you’re feeling — no typing required. Voice Comments are rolling out globally over the next month to accounts 18 and older.Let viewers vote directly in the comments with Comment PollsCreators have always found creative ways to turn the comment section into a conversation with their audience. To make that easier, we're announcing Comment Polls, a new way for creators to put decisions directly in their followers' hands. Whether it's picking an outfit, deciding what to cook, or voting on the next video idea.To create a Comment Poll, creators can add a poll when commenting on their own video. Just tap the poll icon in the comment box, choose up to 5 options for followers to vote on, and set a timeframe for how long voting will last. As votes come in, creators can track results directly in the comment section, making it easy to see how the conversation is trending in real time. Comment Polls are now available globally.Take photo comments to the next level with Photo Carousel and Live Photo CommentsPhoto comments have become one of the most loved ways people express themselves on TikTok. And we're making the feature even more useful with two updates: Photo Carousel Comments and Live Photo Comments.With Photo Carousel Comments, people can now add up to 9 photos in a single comment, making it easy to share a full moment instead of just one frame. For instance, if someone wants to react to a travel video with their own vacation photos, they no longer have to pick just one, they can drop the whole album in a single comment.Live Photos capture more than a static image, they capture a moment. With Live Photo Comments, people can upload Live Photos directly from their camera roll, giving the photo comment a brief burst of motion so others get a quick preview of the moment before diving into the full image. Live Photo Comments are now available globally, and Photo Carousel Comments are rolling out globally over the next month.We’re excited to see how creators and fans take reactions to the next level with these updates. ... September 02, 2026 • News , Company TikTok and NFL Renew Partnership with Multiyear Agreement to Bring Global Fans Closer to Football Renewed partnership builds on the growth of the NFL community on TikTok, with opportunities for global fans to discover the sport, connect with players, and engage with football culture throughout the seasonTikTok and the National Football League today announced a multiyear partnership that will bring football fans closer to the game, the players, and the moments that define one of the world’s most captivating sports communities. As part of the agreement, the NFL will expand its presence on the platform, building on the momentum created together over the past several years, as the league continues to grow and reach new audiences around the world.One of the defining moments of the 2025 season came from the Seattle Seahawks’ Super Bowl victory. The track has been discovered by a new generation on TikTok this summer, where the community has used it to soundtrack over 42 million videos and over 55 billion video views, and catapulted it back into the charts worldwide, including the Billboard Global 200 chart where it has spent the last 21 weeks. The track - which now has over 1.8bn streams on Spotify - fueled a wave of nostalgic, emotionally driven content on the platform – from covers and TV edits to personal “the one that got away” reflections including Katy's own reaction to the famous ex she wrote the song about. The track's resurgence led Katy Perry (10m followers) to release a director’s cut featuring new narration from rock legend Stevie Nicks.Katy Perry said: “It's surreal to see The One That Got Away having this moment, all these years later. The thing about music is that you never really know where a song is going to end up, or when someone is going to find it. From seeing it being chosen in the “choose your own adventure” section of my Lifetimes Tour concert film to seeing people discover it on TikTok and make it part of their own stories has been really special to watch. It’s nice to revisit an amazing chapter while watching another unfold.” @tiktok this summer was all about the classic hits. here's to the ones that never got away 💿 #SongsofTheSummer2026 ♬ original sound - TikTok TikTok's US Songs of the SummerKaty Perry's banger may have taken over our feeds, but the TikTok community in the US also embraced quite the range of songs to soundtrack this summer.As 2016 nostalgia swept TikTok this summer, Mac Miller's 'Cinderella (feat. Ty Dolla $ign)' became one of TikTok's biggest love songs of the summer, landing at #2 on the US list. Creators used the track to celebrate their significant others through heartfelt photos and relationship edits.Lenny Kravitz's 1991 hit 'It Ain't Over 'Til It's Over' took the #3 spot, with the TikTok community embracing the song after being featured in FX's Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. and Carolyn Bessette. Something so catchy you can't help but start singing it yourself, even if you don't know the words. This year's crown goes to 'Du Bist Gut Genug' ('You are good enough') by KITSCHKRIEG feat. Blumengarten and Shirin David, the viral track better known by many on TikTok as "Doobie Scoot Canoe". The TikTok global community has had a whole lot of fun with the German lyrics, inspiring thousands of hilarious videos, memes, and creator interpretations (including by BTS' Jung Kook, Steve Lacy and Lizzo) that has become one of the season's most joyful shared jokes.
